title: Trading recap
author: Resident_Fan5199
selftext: Sharing my trading automation journey! After years of trying to build a profitable trading system, I have finally built a simple bot that is so effective! I will be sharing my results daily, and hope you all can follow me and cheer for me through my journey! 💯.  For those wondering my previous posts and why I stopped, well to be transparent my strategy wasn’t performing well anymore, so I had to rework on my bot and build something that can work on any market. Don’t judge or call it a fake, automation is future, and we all have changed or updated their strategy if it wasn’t performing.
